bestOffers/sql.query(
    `select distinct on (p.product_id)
            p.product_id, p.gtin, p.display_name, p.aisle,
            o.price, o.unit_price, o.unit_price_unit, o.mechanic_raw, o.mechanic_kind,
            o.mechanic_params, o.unlock_quantity, o.captured_at,
            si.brand, sh.name as shop_name, sh.city, sh.is_physical
     from offer o
     join store_item si on si.store_item_id = o.store_item_id
     join product p on p.product_id = si.product_id
     join shop sh on sh.shop_id = o.shop_id
     where o.price is not null and p.gtin is not null
     order by p.product_id, o.price asc`,
    [],
  ).then()#0
